results.title: 9 Best Prototyping Tools in 2026
results.content:
Why it's a good prototyping tool: When the question is about a flow, not sensors or production code, Figma answers it without a second app.

Final verdict: The sensible default for teams already designing in Figma.

### 3. ProtoPie

Overview: ProtoPie builds prototypes that respond to the device itself: its camera, its audio input, the phone's tilt. It now leads with AI and calls itself "#1 AI-driven advanced prototyping software," though hardware realism is still its edge.

Key features: [...] Prototyping tools now come in two kinds: interactive tools that link screens and add logic (Figma, ProtoPie, Axure RP), and AI prototyping tools that write real code from a prompt (Lovable and Bolt).
 Five of the nine list a $0 plan up front: Figma, ProtoPie, Justinmind, Lovable and Bolt. UXPin and Proto.io lead with 14- and 15-day free trials, then drop you to a limited free plan. [...] Origami Studio, Meta's free tool with hardware patches and Figma import, lost out to ProtoPie, which covers similar ground with multi-device sync and published plans. Lovable made the same move as v0 and kept its place, because GitHub sync and design-system support matter once a prototype meets an existing product.
